picks.title: ArtStation enables NoAI protection for every artist by default
picks.excerpt: ArtStation has switched NoAI protection on for new and existing uploads and added safeguards against AI crawlers, while admitting its current AI-content filters remain insufficient.
picks.rationale: The default portfolio platform for concept artists flips training-data consent to opt-out — a structural change every designer publishing work online has to act on.

picks.title: Cursor Cloud Agents can now run in Vercel Sandbox
picks.excerpt: Vercel now lets Cursor Cloud Agents execute inside Vercel Sandbox — scale-to-zero workers, isolated microVMs and durable orchestration on infrastructure the team controls.
picks.rationale: Shipped feature, not a claim: the coding agent moves off the laptop onto the same preview pipeline design-to-code work already ships from.

picks.title: Agent-Native Clips: a free Loom alternative that captures browser errors
picks.excerpt: Builder.io released an open-source screen recorder that records a browser bug together with console logs and failed network requests, producing a clip an agent can act on directly.
picks.rationale: Free tool a designer can install today: the same bug recording they already make becomes machine-readable evidence an agent can fix from.

picks.title: Flying high at JetZero
picks.excerpt: JetZero combines advanced modelling, simulation and AI to refine its blended-wing aircraft, using computation to attack engineering problems that have no reference design to copy.
picks.rationale: AI-assisted design doing its hardest job — shaping a form with no precedent rather than optimising a known one; the industrial-design counterweight to software tooling news.

picks.title: Man City fans used AI to design the team's new kit
picks.excerpt: Manchester City's new alternative kit is the first professional football kit designed by fans using generative AI — made with Puma AI Creator, the brand's custom tool — and it will be worn on the pitch.
picks.rationale: Generative AI crosses from concept render into a manufactured, licensed product — the first hard test of who holds authorship in brand design. (og_image is null; ax-media should pull the in-article image via the Playwright fallback for Fast Company.)
